title: Token
description: One word-level token of a verse or title. Tokens are listed in reading order. `word_start` and `word_end` locate the token in the whitespace-separated words of the display text (1-based, inclusive; 0 when the token could not be located). Every other member is an attribute of the source OSIS w element: multi-valued attributes are grouped by scheme and `src` is split into positions, any other attribute is kept as its string value.

token.description: The token text as it appears in the display text.

word_start.description: First whitespace-separated word of the display text the token covers, 1-based.

word_end.description: Last whitespace-separated word the token covers, inclusive.

lemma.description: Lexical identifiers grouped by OSIS scheme, for example {"strong": ["H07225"]}.

morph.description: Morphology codes grouped by OSIS scheme.

src.description: Source word positions of the token; strings only when the source value is not numeric.

n.description: The OSIS n attribute of the word.

type.description: The OSIS type attribute of the word.

subType.description: The OSIS subType attribute of the word.

morphSegmented.description: Present when the word carries a morphological segment.

variant.description: Present when the word is a textual variant.

variantType.description: The variant's subType when the source supplies one.

additionalProperties.description: Any other attribute of the source w element, kept as its string value.
